camel_example: aliyun esa ListSites --region cn-hangzhou --Status pending --OrderBy visitTime --SiteSearchType fuzzy --SiteName 'example.com' --PageSize 20 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aekzd3styujvyei' --PageNumber 1 --TagFilter '[{"Value":"aaa","Key":"tag1"}]' --PlanSubscribeType basicplan --Coverage global --OnlyEnterprise false --AccessType NS
description_en: Queries the list of sites under the current user, including site names, statuses, and configurations
description_zh: 用于查询当前用户下的站点列表 ，包括站点的名称、状态、配置等信息
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-sites --site-name example.com --site-search-type fuzzy --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --tag-filter Value=aaa Key=tag1 --resource-group-id rg-aekzd3styujvyei --status pending --only-enterprise false --plan-subscribe-type basicplan --coverage global --access-type NS --order-by visitTime --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSites

parameters.help_en: The site name. Used as a filter condition for the query
parameters.help_zh: 站点名称。用于查询的过滤条件
parameters.name: site_name

parameters.help_en:
The search matching mode for the site name. Default is exact match. Valid values:

prefix: prefix match.
suffix: suffix match.
exact: exact match.
fuzzy: fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh:
站点名称的搜索匹配模式。默认为精确匹配，取值：

prefix：前缀匹配。
suffix：后缀匹配。
exact：精确匹配。
fuzzy：模糊匹配
parameters.name: site_search_type

parameters.help_en: The page number for paging. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

element_fields.help_en: The tag key. Used as a filter condition for the query
element_fields.help_zh: 标签键，用于查询的过滤条件
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en: The tag value. Used as a filter condition for the query
element_fields.help_zh: 标签值，用于查询的过滤条件
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. Used as a filter condition for the query
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。用于查询的过滤条件
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The site status. Used as a filter condition for the query
parameters.help_zh: 站点状态。用于查询的过滤条件
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query only Enterprise Edition sites. Set this parameter to true to query only Enterprise Edition sites
parameters.help_zh: 仅企业版，传true时代表仅查询企业版的站点
parameters.name: only_enterprise

parameters.help_en:
The plan subscription type. Valid values:
basicplan: Basic Edition.
standardplan: Standard Edition.
advancedplan: Premium Edition.
enterpriseplan: Enterprise Edition
parameters.help_zh:
套餐订阅类型。取值：
basicplan: 基础版。
standardplan：标准版。
advancedplan：高级版。
enterpriseplan：企业版
parameters.name: plan_subscribe_type

parameters.help_en:
The acceleration region. Valid values:
domestic: the Chinese mainland only.
global: global.
overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland)
parameters.help_zh:
加速区域。取值：
domestic：仅中国内地。
global：全球。
overseas：全球（不包含中国内地）
parameters.name: coverage

parameters.help_en:
The access type. Valid values:

NS: NS-based access.

CNAME: CNAME-based access
parameters.help_zh:
接入类型。取值：

NS：通过NS托管接入。

CNAME：通过CNAME接入
parameters.name: access_type

parameters.help_en:
The sort field. By default, results are sorted by creation time. Valid values:
gmtCreate: site creation time.
visitTime: site access time
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认按照创建时间排序，支持
gmtCreate：站点创建时间
visitTime：站点访问时间
parameters.name: order_by
